描述_ZN: Narrative of Shen Zhou" scroll, Qianlong, Qing dynasty, in Jin Nongshu, regular script on paper, 155.4 cm in length and 36.9 cm in width. 　　This work is a record of an allusion to Shen Zhou, reflecting his quality of non-attachment to power and nobility, and his noble and elegant nature. Jin Nong's calligraphy is a blend of regular and clerical script, and his "lacquer script" is particularly strange and ancient. This scroll has many sideways strokes, with sharp edges and sharp angles, and the starting and closing strokes are deliberately straight and shaped, with thick horizontal strokes and thin straight strokes, and the outlines are mostly sent out in waves by turning the strokes. The brush strokes are strong and heavy, and the ink is thick, suggesting the legacy of the seal script.　　Comment: "The new construction of Cao's courtyard was completed, and he wanted to paint its pillars, and the history of Shi Tian's name was in the register.
